newsitem.title: USA: United Vanguard IPO postponed - underwriter.
newsitem.headline: United Vanguard IPO postponed - underwriter.

text.p: The initial public offering of United Vanguard Homes Inc has been "indefinitely postponed due to market conditions," lead underwriter for the deal Janney Montgomery Scott Inc said on Monday.

United Vanguard, a Delaware-based owner, manager and developer of homes for the elderly, was expected to go public with 1.8 million units, each unit representing one common share and one warrant, in a price range of $7.50 to $9.50 per unit.
The IPO did not have a specific date for its market debut but was on a week to week schedule, the underwriter said.
